name: nepali-asr-benchmark-50gb
description:
Nepali ASR Benchmark Dataset (50GB)
	

A large-scale, professionally curated dataset for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) research in the Nepali language. This benchmark contains high-fidelity audio segments with corresponding transcriptions, optimized for training and evaluating speech recognition models.

reputation: A valuable, professionally curated resource for Nepali ASR with growing adoption among speech researchers focusing on low-resource languages.
